title: CB Reddy Steward signs ERFA tender with Cowboys

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: CB Reddy Steward signs ERFA tender with Cowboys
sources.description: Cornerback Reddy Steward wasn't able to talk to other teams after being tendered by the Cowboys as an exclusive rights free agent and he's now officially back on the roster in Dallas.
